sections.title: Habit and fruit
sections.text: The coconut palm is a tropical palm with a single, unbranched trunk that can reach about 30 m. Its large pinnate leaves may be up to 6 m long. The fruit is a drupe about 30 × 25 cm, with fibrous husk and a hard shell.

sections.title: Edible parts
sections.text: The seed contains edible white flesh and liquid endosperm, or coconut water; many food products are made from it. The plate accurately shows the palm and a cross-section of the fruit. Its domestication and dispersal history is complex, so no single simple origin is assigned.
